_comment: Expected panel output for the F2b calibration set (deterministic-orchestration-v2 only). Every entry is an ARBITER-SETTLED answer: Vargas/Lyu/Jin carry over from the original facet's settled positives (§147b; -v2 is a superset); Töpfer, Mahmud and Parris were settled by the arbiter on 2026-10-04 (§151). Töpfer and Mahmud are deliberately NOT named in the instrument, so they test whether the form-(c) definition reads correctly rather than whether the panel can copy an example.
_scoring: Fails if a must is missed or a must_not fires at >=2/3 vendor agreement.

UB2EVUFU.author: Lyu
UB2EVUFU.why: §147b mixed positive (form a): code phases, model staffing.

UDVHQ5HR.author: Jin
UDVHQ5HR.why: §147b/§148c positive, form (b) only: code flips the judge's verdict on executable evidence.

72W6R4JG.author: Töpfer
72W6R4JG.why: Arbiter 2026-10-04 (§151): code builds the prompt, calls the LLM to generate the adaptation manager, runs it under the FCL verifier, feeds violations back for repair — form (c) [+ (a)]. The ORIGINAL facet was settled NO here (precondition 2); this is the contrast that proves the widening.

R9CDT9KB.author: Mahmud
R9CDT9KB.why: Arbiter 2026-10-04 (§151): fixed code pipeline classification → impact → action, three LLMs as classifiers, code-computed trust score and thresholds mapping to CI gate actions — form (c) + (b). The F2 panel withheld the original here (2/3 codex+gemini emitted, opus withheld on precondition 2).

3SU9QZ6F.author: Parris
3SU9QZ6F.why: Arbiter 2026-10-04 (§151): all three studies use AIRA's deterministic engine only; the optional LLM/hybrid scan mode is reported separately as a comparison. Tests precondition 2: a pipeline with no model step does not fire.
